start.name: {name}
start.text: *April. Cherry blossoms scatter in the breeze.*

start_2.name: {name}
start_2.text: *My uniform is still stiff. There's a faint smell of starch. Even though I ironed it yesterday, the creases have a mind of their own. Already off to a bad start with this uniform.*

start_3.name: {name}
start_3.text: *Starting today, I'm a student at this school. A transfer. First time.*

start_3b.name: {name}
start_3b.text: *My hand fidgets with the edge of my phone inside my pocket. I hate to admit it, but it's a habit that only comes out when I'm nervous.*

start_4.name: {name}
start_4.text: *My phone buzzes in my pocket. The old school group chat. I see a name flash on the screen — and shove the phone back in. Not yet.*

start_5.name: {name}
start_5.text: *A cherry blossom petal brushes my nose. — I almost sneezed. If this were a drama, this is the part where some pretty girl bumps into me.*

name_input_scene.name: System
name_input_scene.text: Transfer student, what is your name?

gate_1.name: {name}
gate_1.text: *I'm standing in front of an unfamiliar school gate. It's a pretty big school. Clean buildings, spacious grounds.*

gate_2.name: {name}
gate_2.text: *Students pass through the gate in small groups. My uniform is the only one blindingly crisp. Like a billboard — 'I'm new here.'*

gate_3.name: {name}
gate_3.text: *A girl is standing by the gate. She casually flips her long black hair — behind her glasses, her steps are relaxed. Not a hint of hurry.*

seoyeon_meet_2.name: {name}
seoyeon_meet_2.text: *Her voice is calm. Not cold, but measured — like she already knows how this conversation ends.*

seoyeon_meet_4.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_4.text: I'm the student council president. Guiding new students is my job.

seoyeon_meet_5.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_5.text: Follow me. I'll show you around.

seoyeon_meet_6.name: {name}
seoyeon_meet_6.text: The president herself? That's too kind.

seoyeon_meet_7.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_7.text: Whether it's too kind or not — that's for me to decide.

seoyeon_meet_8.name: {name}
seoyeon_meet_8.text: *She smirks. Just the corners of her lips lifting. — Before I knew it, I was smiling back.*

seoyeon_meet_9.name: {name}
seoyeon_meet_9.text: *Seoyeon walks toward the gate, beckoning with a wave.*

seoyeon_choice.name: {name}
choices: Don't tell me you came out early because you're interested in me?
How much is the guide fee?
I'm good. I'll just wander around on my own.

choice_dismiss_1.name: Seoyeon
choice_dismiss_1.text: *She stops. Turns her head slightly to glance back.*

choice_dismiss_2.name: Seoyeon
choice_dismiss_2.text: Oh, really? Then at least memorize the classroom number. It's Class 3-2, at the very end on the right.

choice_dismiss_3.name: {name}
choice_dismiss_3.text: *Seoyeon really turned away. Without even a wave. I fumbled along the hallway map and barely made it to the classroom. — I made my choice, and the responsibility is mine.*

choice_flirt_1.name: {name}
choice_flirt_1.text: *Seoyeon stops walking and turns around. Not surprised — more amused.*

choice_flirt_2.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_2.text: Wow. You're not holding back on the first day. I'll remember your name quickly.

choice_flirt_4.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_4.text: Must be the transfer student thing — you don't know how to read the room. That's fun.

choice_flirt_6.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_6.text: You don't know yet if it's flattery or disaster.

choice_flirt_7.name: {name}
choice_flirt_7.text: *A student council president with this kind of energy on the first day. — Not bad.*

choice_joke_1.name: Seoyeon
choice_joke_1.text: It's free. — But the interest builds up later.

choice_joke_2.name: {name}
choice_joke_2.text: That's one scary student council president.

choice_joke_3.name: Seoyeon
choice_joke_3.text: At least it won't be boring.

hallway_1.name: {name}
hallway_1.text: *Seoyeon guides me through the hallway. Passing students greet her. She acknowledges each one with a nod.*

hallway_2.name: {name}
hallway_2.text: *Seoyeon waves back casually. So natural. Seems like this school's social hierarchy is already set.*

hallway_3.name: Seoyeon
hallway_3.text: Third-year building is here, library's over there. School store is in the basement.

hallway_4.name: {name}
hallway_4.text: *Seoyeon pulls out a key from her pocket and gives it a little shake.*

hallway_5.name: Seoyeon
hallway_5.text: The rooftop is usually locked. Student council president privilege.

hallway_6.name: {name}
hallway_6.text: You got a secret hideout or something?

hallway_8.name: {name}
hallway_8.text: *Suddenly I have lunch plans. — I never even said yes.*

hallway_9.name: {name}
hallway_9.text: *We arrive in front of the classroom.*

hallway_10.name: Seoyeon
hallway_10.text: Here it is. Go on in.

hallway_11.name: {name}
hallway_11.text: Will you guide me at lunch too?

hallway_12.name: Seoyeon
hallway_12.text: That depends on how well you do.

hallway_13.name: {name}
hallway_13.text: *Seoyeon turns and gives a light wave. She doesn't look back.*

classroom_1.name: {name}
classroom_1.text: *I open the classroom door. All eyes land on me.*

classroom_2.name: {name}
classroom_2.text: *I expected it, but the weight of 30 stares is still heavy.*

classroom_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_3.text: Everyone, we have a transfer student joining our class today. Go ahead and introduce yourself.

classroom_4.name: {name}
classroom_4.text: I'm {name}. Nice to meet you all.

classroom_5.name: {name}
classroom_5.text: *Short and clean. No point in dragging it out.*

classroom_6.name: {name}
classroom_6.text: *A whistle from one side of the room.*

classroom_dain_1.name: Dain
classroom_dain_1.text: Oh! A boy transfer student! Finally.

classroom_dain_2.name: {name}
classroom_dain_2.text: *Brown short cut. Wearing a volleyball team uniform. A voice bursting with energy. She's half out of her seat. The girl next to her pulls at her sleeve, but it's no use.*

classroom_dain_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_dain_3.text: Dain, please quiet down... And stop wearing your jersey in class.

classroom_dain_4.name: Dain
classroom_dain_4.text: Aw, teach, this is just what feels most comfortable. Anyway, nice to meet you, transfer student!

classroom_dain_5.name: {name}
classroom_dain_5.text: *She has no volume control. But her face is so genuinely happy that you can't dislike her.*

classroom_yuna_1.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_1.text: *I shift my gaze and spot a girl in the far back by the window, resting her chin on her hand, staring outside. She seems uninterested in my introduction.*

classroom_yuna_2.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_2.text: *Silver-white hair. Red eyes, half-closed and drowsy. Tattoos cover her arms. — She doesn't even glance this way. As if a transfer student is nothing special.*

classroom_yuna_3.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_3.text: *The students around her don't look in Yuna's direction. Deliberately. As if no one's sitting there at all.*

classroom_yuna_4.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_4.text: *Someone in the front row whispers. '...Don't talk to her, she's scary.' — Close enough for Yuna to hear. But her expression doesn't change. She's used to it.*

classroom_seat_1.name: {name}
classroom_seat_1.text: *The homeroom teacher points to an empty seat.*

classroom_seat_2.name: {name}
classroom_seat_2.text: *It's next to Dain. Saved — or doomed — I'm not sure which, but at least it won't be quiet.*

classroom_minsu_1.name: {name}
classroom_minsu_1.text: *As I go to sit down — the boy in the seat ahead turns around.*

classroom_minsu_2.name: Minsu
classroom_minsu_2.text: Hey, transfer kid. Welcome. — And a word of advice.

classroom_dain_talk_1.name: {name}
classroom_dain_talk_1.text: *Good to know there's at least one sensible person here. — His name tag says 'Minsu.'*

classroom_dain_talk_2.name: {name}
classroom_dain_talk_2.text: *The moment I sit down, Dain leans in. Zero concept of personal space.*

classroom_dain_talk_5.name: Dain
classroom_dain_talk_5.text: Just asking! I need someone to hit the gym with after school! Someone to toss balls for me!

classroom_dain_talk_7.name: Dain
classroom_dain_talk_7.text: Hahaha, you're probably better than a ball machine! Probably!

classroom_dain_talk_8.name: {name}
classroom_dain_talk_8.text: *She said 'probably.' Meaning I might be better than a ball machine. My position is precarious.*

classroom_yuna_note_1.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_1.text: *A folded note lands on my desk. — I look back and the girl with the silver-white hair by the window is staring outside again. Despite her tattoo-covered arms — the handwriting on the note is neat.*

classroom_yuna_note_3.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_3.text: *'Got stuck with the noisy seat. — Yuna'*

classroom_yuna_note_4.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_4.text: *Lavender ink. — My tension eases a little.*

classroom_yuna_note_5.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_5.text: *I glance toward Yuna. She's still looking out the window. But I think the tip of her ear just moved.*

classroom_yuna_note_6.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_6.text: *Class starts. Yuna is looking out the window again. Dain is already chatting with the person next to her.*

hallway_6_ins2.name: {name}
hallway_6_ins2.text: *That hesitation. Half a second. Probably nothing, but somehow it sticks.*

hallway_7.name: Seoyeon
hallway_7.text: Oh, lunch. You don't know where the cafeteria is, right? Come with me.

hallway_13_ins.name: {name}
hallway_13_ins.text: *Her back is straight. Perfectly straight. — As if practiced. I got a little curious about what's behind that composure.*

classroom_2_ins.name: {name}
classroom_2_ins.text: *The homeroom teacher stands at the podium. Late twenties. Her cardigan hangs open from the start. Her expression is indifferent, but — her eyes are scanning each student one by one.*

classroom_3_ins.name: {name}
classroom_3_ins.text: *Her voice is dry. Not emotionless, just — carrying exactly as much feeling as needed. Surprisingly, I don't mind it.*

classroom_5_ins.name: {name}
classroom_5_ins.text: *The teacher nods. She was about to say something more — stops, and glances at the attendance sheet on the podium again. Her right hand is fidgeting with a pen in her pocket. Must be a habit.*

classroom_5_ins2.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_5_ins2.text: ...Right. {name}. I'll remember that. *Quietly, almost to herself* I make it a point to memorize names on the first try.

classroom_5_ins3.name: {name}
classroom_5_ins3.text: *Nobody else heard that. Only me. — Is she attentive, or is it just a habit?*

classroom_dain_5_ins.name: {name}
classroom_dain_5_ins.text: *The teacher lets out a small sigh. Not exasperation — the kind of sigh that comes from familiarity.*

classroom_dain_5_ins2.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_dain_5_ins2.text: ...Save some energy. First period hasn't even started yet.

classroom_dain_5_ins3.name: {name}
classroom_dain_5_ins3.text: *She says it dryly, but the corner of her mouth is slightly upturned. Her default is expressionless, but every now and then there's a glitch.*

classroom_yuna_note_5_ins.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_5_ins.text: *The one who sent the note is the girl who was staring out the window earlier. Hard to tell if she's faking disinterest or genuinely doesn't care.*
